text:
Lina: Heads up — saw a sudden jump in per-token spend on /v2/generate this morning around 08:12, but request traces show many callers not setting a version header.
Lina: looks like implicit inference is promoting requests to v2 when header missing. dashboard: https://dash.internal/r/route-spend?span=2h
Arjun: hmm we flipped prefer-v2-load-balancing last week to better utilize new capacity, wonder if that interacts with our version-fallback rules.
Tanya: router policy is: if header missing -> run heuristic to pick variant. heuristic recently changed to bias toward matching recent tenant distribution. could explain the lift.
Lina: example payload from the trace: `{
  "input": "Explain Kubernetes RBAC...",
  "max_tokens": 256
}` — no `x-redwood-version`.
Arjun: that max_tokens seems moderate. why would heuristic pick a larger model?
Tanya: because heuristic also factors in prompt length estimate and tenant historical seqlen. we added a safety margin to avoid truncation, but margin may be too aggressive.
Lina: impact: tokens/hr for that route up ~3x for affected tenants. some small customers hit our higher-cost SKU unexpectedly.
infra-bot: flag rollback suggested: feature flag `prefer-v2-load-balancing` -> rollback in 2m if no objections.
Arjun: rollback is fine as immediate mitigation. we also should throttle unknown-version traffic to protect customers and billing.
Tanya: agree. propose short-term controls: (1) revert load-balance change (2) add runtime metric `inferred_version` with bucketed counts (declared=v1, declared=v2, inferred=v1, inferred=v2) (3) soft quota: unknown-version tokens per-tenant capped at 100k/hr to limit shock
Lina: +1 to telemetry. for (2) I want that surfaced in the route console as a stacked bar: tokens by (declared vs inferred) so SEs can see who needs to upgrade.
Arjun: operational note: we should emit an annotation in responses for inferred routing: `X-Redwood-Route-Decision: inferred=v2` so clients can see it's not their header causing it. low friction and helpful for debugging.
Tanya: will add that header on the router canary. also emit `api_version_inference` event to our ingest stream with {tenant, declared_version, inferred_version, decision_reason, est_seq_bucket}.
Lina: decision_reason could be short strings like `hist_bias` or `prompt_len_margin`. keep it small.
BillingBot: suggested billing safeguard: auto-credit customers for first day of unexpected overage when caused by inferred-upgrade, and block billing escalation until tenant confirms. need product signoff.
Arjun: good interim. for long term we need an RFC: default fallback semantics when version absent, how to handle deprecations, and console affordances for tenants who want conservative routing.
Tanya: draft outline for RFC: detection & telemetry, default route fallback (prefer lower-cost vs prefer latest), per-tenant opt-in/opt-out flags, quota shielding, server-side hint header, and UI nudges.
Lina: immediate owners: rollback & watch 1h: Arjun; telemetry event + stream: Tanya; console chart quick patch: Lina -> create ticket PLAT-6732; billing credits flow: Lina + Billing team.
Arjun: rolling rollback now. infra: https://infra.internal/flags/prefer-v2-load-balancing status page.
Arjun: rollback applied to canary then prod if canary stable.
Lina: canary looks cleaner already, token spend dropping ~55% on canary nodes.
Tanya: I'll start the `api_version_inference` event implement and wire to ingestion pipeline. expect first samples in ~12m.
Lina: also let's add a tiny console banner on affected routes: "Some requests without an API version header were routed to a newer variant. Click for remediation steps." link -> PLAT-6732
Arjun: agree. also flag for SDK teams to ensure new SDKs set explicit `x-redwood-version`. can we add a deprecation banner in SDK repos?
Tanya: yes, will coordinate with DevEx.
Lina: follow-ups: (A) prod incident note + customer outreach draft (Lina), (B) quota protection rollout (Lina+Billing), (C) long-term RFC (Tanya+Arjun), (D) console visibility patch (Lina).
Lina: thanks everyone — keeping thread live for postmortem and RCA. pinning for 24h.
